[Pre-reflection] The strategy's reliance on multiple filters may cause overfitting or reduce signal frequency, especially with tight thresholds like RSI < 70 and ADX > 25. The exit rule based on bollinger.middle band crossing may be too sensitive, leading to premature exits. It lacks position sizing, transaction costs, and drawdown tracking — key metrics for robustness.
[Backup plan] If results are poor, reduce ADX threshold to 20 and loosen RSI filter to 75. If Sharpe is low, increase ATR-based stop-loss or implement dynamic position sizing. As an alternative, try a momentum-based breakout with volatility-adjusted entry/exit rules using only Bollinger Bands and ATR, eliminating RSI and ADX.
